What are the molecular mechanisms underpinning local adaptation? Reciprocal transplant of mustard hill coral from a variable to a more stable habitat demonstrates that populations exhibit phenotypic signatures consistent with local adaptation.

#1552 2016-11-07 进化生物
An invasive social insect overcomes genetic load at the sex locus
Rosalyn Gloag; Guiling Ding; Benjamin P. Oldroyd
Hymenopteran social insects require heterozygosity at thecsdlocus for female development. Here, it is shown how balancing selection overcomes founder effects to maintain this heterozygosity and allow the Asian honeybee to become invasive.
